name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-center-of-the-enlightened-corridors-of-time-remix
title: Chrono Trigger - Center of the Enlightened ~ Corridors Of Time (Remix)
description:
Did a birthday special arrangement of Corridors Of Time from Chrono Trigger. Thought it'd be great to celebrate my birthday with another special remix once again and also give myself an excuse to make a remix of a Chrono Trigger theme but make it SPECIAL.

Chrono Trigger is one of my favorite games of all-time, and I believe the game deserves as much praise as it keeps on getting. It's not only a one-of-a-kind SquEnix RPG, but also probably one of the best video games ever made. It's easily one of the best experiences I ever had with a video game, and I'm sure it was the same for morbillions of others as well.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
